pages.title: Fruit Blast
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Fruit Blast asks you to clear matching fruit pieces and meet each level's goals. Look for combinations that produce stronger effects and use boosters when a board becomes difficult. Complete the required targets to continue through the fruit-puzzle stages.

pages.title: Barbee And Friends Graduation Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Barbee And Friends Graduation Party lets you style Barbee and her friends for graduation. Choose clothing for the occasion and coordinate each character's look, comparing outfits as the group prepares to celebrate finishing their studies together.

pages.title: Slide Rabbit
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Slide Rabbit sends a rabbit across a field of food and hazards. Swipe in four directions to choose a route, eating what you can while avoiding holes, wolves and spikes. Contact with a danger ends the attempt.

pages.title: Elixir Drop
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Elixir Drop turns falling potions into a merging puzzle. Move an elixir sideways and drop it into the container, bringing matching colors together to form more advanced potions. Work toward a rainbow elixir without letting the contents cross the overflow line.

pages.title: ColorWars.io
pages.creator: KEPLER YAZILIM
pages.description: ColorWars.io asks you to expand a colored territory while defending it from rivals. Leave your area to draw a trail and return to secure the new ground. Protect the trail from enemy shots and spend earned gold on defensive structures.

pages.title: Sakura Branch
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Sakura Branch gives you disconnected pieces of a dried branch to restore. Rotate the sections until they connect with the living portion, carrying life through the whole arrangement. Completing the network makes the branch bloom with flowers.

pages.title: Heroic Knight
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Heroic Knight turns rescuing a princess and recovering treasure into pin-removal puzzles. Pull the barriers in a useful order to open a safe path for the knight, keeping trolls and lava from reaching him as the scene changes.

pages.title: Idle Pop Merge
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Idle Pop Merge lets you build a stronger team by combining characters on a board. Drag units into slots so matching neighbors merge into an improved version, then keep arranging the remaining characters to create the next upgrade.

pages.title: Zombie Survival
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Zombie Survival sends you into environments overrun by zombies. Explore the routes, gather weapons and set traps to defend against approaching waves. Move through abandoned streets and forests while preparing for the stronger enemies encountered during the adventure.

pages.title: Merge Brainrot
pages.creator: Colormind Games
pages.description: Merge Brainrot drops meme characters into a merging play area. Position the next piece and release it onto a matching character to create a new one, planning the pile so further combinations can continue as the collection grows.

pages.title: Bull Runner
pages.creator: Nexus
pages.description: Bull Runner puts you in control of a charging bull. Steer left and right through obstacles and groups of stickmen, smashing what stands in its path. Keep the charge going to discover how far the bull can travel before it is stopped.

pages.title: Save the cats - Bubble shooter
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Save the cats - Bubble shooter asks you to free cats by clearing a bubble-filled field. Aim with the guide and use wall rebounds to reach matching colors. Check the next bubble and bring boosters into the harder level arrangements.

pages.title: Friday Night Sprunki
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Friday Night Sprunki turns its character encounters into rhythm battles. Hit the displayed arrows in time with the changing music, completing the songs to defeat the other performers. Work through twelve musical levels while trying to improve your score.

pages.title: Eye Art Perfect Makeup Artist
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Eye Art Perfect Makeup Artist focuses on designing eye makeup across twenty-six looks. Work through the cosmetic choices for each style, selecting details around the eyes and combining them into a finished design for the character.

pages.title: Cryptograph
pages.creator: Justforward
pages.description: Cryptograph asks you to decode a quotation by replacing numbered spaces with letters. Each number represents a particular letter, so use repeated patterns and known words to infer the missing text. Complete the saying to move to another cryptogram.

pages.title: Extreme Car Race Master 3D
pages.creator: SadaatGames
pages.description: Extreme Car Race Master 3D puts your car on tracks crowded with obstacles and rivals. Adjust the vehicle's setup and steer around the hazards, keeping the race moving at speed as you look for room to get past the competition.

pages.title: Hero Pipe
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description: Hero Pipe challenges you to connect pipes that control the outcome of a rescue. Route lava or poisonous gas toward enemies while keeping the hero and princess safe. Complete the pipe arrangement so the hero can recover the treasure and finish the mission.

pages.title: Mini Obby War Game
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Mini Obby War Game sends a small fighter through battles in a block-styled world. Keep moving to avoid enemy fire, aim at approaching troops and reload when needed. Work through the levels using shooting, sprinting and jumps to negotiate each encounter.

pages.title: Solitaire Match
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Solitaire Match links developing a village with a card-clearing puzzle. Select cards that total ten to remove them and earn coins, working toward the stage's required income. Avoid filling the available slots before reaching the coin target.

pages.title: Gun Rush
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Gun Rush sends a team through a course of weapons and obstacles toward a gold chest. Choose equipment, build the group and defeat the opponents blocking its route, steering past hazards as you work toward the finish.

pages.title: Noob archer monster attack
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Noob archer monster attack develops a beginner archer through battles with enemies and bosses. Hold to draw the bow and release to fire, balancing shot strength against stamina. Hitting different body areas changes the damage dealt during an encounter.

pages.title: American Police SUV Simulator
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: American Police SUV Simulator puts you in a police SUV pursuing criminals across a city. Steer along the streets and use nitro when additional speed helps the chase. Work through the driving tasks as you bring the vehicle into position to catch offenders.

pages.title: Bird Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Bird Sort Puzzle asks you to group birds by color on tree branches. Select a bird and move it to a branch holding the same color with enough room available. Plan transfers around the free spaces until the birds are sorted.

pages.title: Diamond Mermaids
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Diamond Mermaids lets you design a sparkling look for an underwater character. Choose makeup, a hairstyle, a top and accessories, combining the selections into your own mermaid doll. Save the completed style when the appearance is ready.

pages.title: EvoHero - Idle Gladiators
pages.creator: NIGHT STEED S.C.
pages.description: EvoHero - Idle Gladiators puts you in charge of training fighters and developing an arena. Drag matching gladiators together to improve them and click the training dummy to earn money. Reinvest the earnings as you strengthen the group and expand the operation.

pages.title: Squid Mahjong Connect 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Squid Mahjong Connect 2 challenges you to remove matching squid-themed tile pairs. Find connections through the remaining layout and keep clearing the board. Hint and shuffle buttons offer help when no useful pairing is easy to spot.

pages.title: Real Drift Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Real Drift Racing sends a cartoon car forward automatically along platform tracks. Hold to control the timing of each drift through the corners, judging when to turn so the vehicle stays on the route and reaches the finish.

pages.title: Hexoboy. Blue world
pages.creator: ALMA Games
pages.description: Hexoboy. Blue world follows a small hero through a hexagonal platforming adventure. Move and jump through the stages, solving puzzles and working around obstacles as you find the route that lets Hexoboy continue his journey.

pages.title: Grand Nitro Formula
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Grand Nitro Formula offers championship racing, practice runs and time attacks in formula cars. Pick a mode and vehicle, then use steering, braking and nitro to handle the circuit. Customize cars as you develop your collection and race results.

pages.title: BFF Christmas Tree Hairstyle And Biscuits
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Christmas Tree Hairstyle And Biscuits helps Ava, Mia and Sophie prepare for Christmas. Follow the sugar-biscuit recipe, then choose festive outfits and create tree-inspired hairstyles. Work through both the kitchen activities and the friends' holiday styling.

pages.title: SHAPES
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: SHAPES presents objects that need to be matched with the correct geometric shapes. Compare the outlines and drag the suitable item into place, working through the activity by identifying the form represented in each example.

pages.title: Tiny Clash
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Tiny Clash lets you build an army by combining identical warriors. Drag matching troops together to strengthen the force and develop its commander, then send the group against the enemy. Continue upgrading the army as you work through the clashes.

pages.title: Ellie Fashion Police
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Ellie Fashion Police follows a fashion adviser helping princesses change their looks. Identify the characters needing a makeover and choose replacement outfits for them, combining the wardrobe pieces into a new style for each participant.

pages.title: Cars and Road
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Cars and Road asks you to connect matching cars to recolor their road tiles. Draw a chain through at least three neighboring cars horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Turn every road block blue to complete each of the twenty-four stages.

pages.title: Swipe Ball
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Swipe Ball challenges you to collect diamonds while bombs threaten the play area. Move the ball through clear spaces and react to the hazards around it, gathering more diamonds as you try to improve the score without being caught by an explosion.

pages.title: Adventure Craft
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Adventure Craft turns block mining into a timed chain-matching puzzle. Click and drag through similar blocks to form a large connected group, clearing it for points. Meet the stage's requirements before the allowance ends to continue through the voxel-themed boards.

pages.title: Pop Pop Kitties
pages.creator: b10b
pages.description: Pop Pop Kitties asks you to clear kitty-shaped pieces by shooting at matching groups. Connect at least three identical kitties to pop them, removing the whole field before it reaches the bottom or time runs out. Faster clears earn more stars.

pages.title: Bubble Game 3: Christmas Edition
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bubble Game 3: Christmas Edition gives bubble shooting a winter holiday setting. Aim and fire toward matching colors to clear the arrangement, looking for useful groups among the remaining bubbles as you continue the Christmas-themed round.

pages.title: Super MX New Race
pages.creator: Barnzmu
pages.description: Super MX New Race puts a dirt-bike rider into races against rival motorcyclists. Control the bike through the course's terrain and use its physics to manage the ride, working toward wins in the challenges against the game's champions.

pages.title: Time To Park 2
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Time To Park 2 asks you to complete parking missions quickly and carefully. Steer the car to its space without leaving the road or striking another vehicle. A faster finish improves the score and helps earn three stars for the stage.

pages.title: Colorful Dinosaurs Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Colorful Dinosaurs Match 3 asks you to arrange dinosaur tiles into rows of at least three matching pieces. Make combinations for points while keeping the side gauge from draining too low, continuing the round by finding the next available match.

pages.title: Nonogram 1000!
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Nonogram 1000! reveals pictures through numbered grid clues. Fill the cells that belong to each row's and column's groups, leaving the others blank. Compare the crossing clues to determine where each unbroken run of colored squares must go.

pages.title: Anime Kawaii Dress Up
pages.creator: loko8
pages.description: Anime Kawaii Dress Up offers six dolls to style with a mix of fashion themes. Combine Japanese streetwear, everyday clothing, fairy-tale pieces and futuristic looks, creating an anime-style avatar and a picture of the finished outfit.

pages.title: Real Garbage truck
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Real Garbage truck puts you in charge of a waste-collection vehicle. Drive to the pickup points, use the collection action to load garbage and continue through the assigned route. Complete the truck's missions while keeping its movement controlled between stops.

pages.title: Killing the Virus
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Killing the Virus turns colorful virus icons into a group-clearing puzzle. Connect at least two matching pieces to remove them and score points. Groups of six or more create a bomb, rewarding larger connections with an effect that helps clear more of the board.

pages.title: Rolling Domino Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Rolling Domino Online asks you to topple walls of domino-like pieces to reveal a complete pattern. Slide to guide the action around obstacles, collecting keys and opening boxes along the way. Finished stages provide opportunities to unlock different skins.

pages.title: Balls Will Fall
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Balls Will Fall challenges you to keep a character clear of balls dropping into the play area. Move with the mouse or touch controls and watch the next descent, choosing open spaces so the falling objects do not end the attempt.

pages.title: Free robux Games Roblox Spin Wheel
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Free robux Games Roblox Spin Wheel uses two spinning wheels for a points challenge. Spin to determine the round's result, then try the second wheel for a chance to increase the score or lose it. The activity centers on the game's points.

pages.title: Warlock
pages.creator: Matt Lloyd
pages.description: Warlock follows a hero exploring a fantasy world threatened by evil. Enter dungeons, fight the monsters inside and continue the adventure through its encounters, working toward defeating the force threatening the surrounding land.

pages.title: HyperMotion
pages.creator: kalem
pages.description: HyperMotion turns drag-and-release aiming into a physics-ball challenge. Choose the direction and strength of a launch to reach the next targets, building score and combos. Adjust the shots as the game's layouts and difficulty change.

pages.title: Real Stunts Drift Car Driving 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Real Stunts Drift Car Driving 3D gives you modified cars to drive through streets and hilly areas. Use ramps for jumps and rolls, then control the landing and drift through the route. Nitro adds speed when a stunt needs a stronger approach.

pages.title: Overloaded Bus
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Overloaded Bus asks you to manage groups of passengers boarding and leaving a bus. Tap to pick people up or drop them off, keeping the load within the vehicle's limit. Avoid overcrowding it enough to trigger an explosion as you progress through the levels.

pages.title: Kitchen Rush
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Kitchen Rush turns kitchen furniture into a jumping course. Leap between shelves, tables, chairs and other household surfaces, judging the next landing as you continue through the room. Use the mouse to control the character's progress across the objects.

pages.title: Clawdeen Wolf flirting Dressup
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Clawdeen Wolf flirting Dressup lets you create a look for the Monster High student. Choose clothing and coordinate the available fashion pieces around Clawdeen's appearance, experimenting with combinations before settling on her finished outfit.

pages.title: Mafia Billiard Tricks
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Mafia Billiard Tricks introduces pool challenges through a succession of Mafia opponents. Set the cue angle and power to pocket the required balls, learning each henchman's puzzle rules before taking on a regular match against the family members.

pages.title: Halloween Evil Blast
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Halloween Evil Blast fills a matching puzzle with demon faces. Select useful combinations of at least three identical demons to clear them, working through the Halloween-themed arrangement and looking for the next set among the remaining pieces.

pages.title: BMX Rider Impossible Stunt Racing : Bicycle Stunt
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: BMX Rider Impossible Stunt Racing : Bicycle Stunt puts a BMX bike onto elevated stunt tracks. Steer across the narrow course, jump when needed and manage the bicycle's position around obstacles, aiming to complete the route without falling from the ramps.

pages.title: Crashy Cat
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Crashy Cat asks you to rescue a cat by destroying blocks in its way. Tap the pieces to change the arrangement and guide the character through the level, considering how each removal helps the rescue while working toward three stars.

pages.title: Rope Rescue Unique Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Rope Rescue Unique Puzzle asks you to bring people safely to a platform using a rope. Plan a route around obstacles and bombs, then guide the characters along it. Keep the line clear of hazards so the group can reach safety.

pages.title: Avocado Puzzle Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Avocado Puzzle Time gives you scattered sections of an avocado picture to restore. Move each small piece into its original position and compare the outlines and image details. There is no timer, so you can complete the scene at your own pace.

pages.title: Ancient Fighters
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Ancient Fighters lets you choose a warrior and face a series of opponents. Use movement, punches and kicks to win the encounters, developing the timing of your attacks. Play against the computer or challenge another player with separate controls.

pages.title: Basketball
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Basketball focuses on putting a ball into the basket with mouse-controlled shots. Line up an attempt and judge its direction toward the hoop, then adjust your next release as you continue the game's scoring challenge.

pages.title: Horse Family Animal Simulator 3D
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Horse Family Animal Simulator 3D follows a horse exploring an island and helping its inhabitants. Complete tasks for villagers and other horses, enter competitions and improve your home. Build a family with foals while protecting the group from forest predators.

pages.title: Princess rescue
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Princess rescue sends a character upward over clouds toward a princess. Use left and right movement to choose the next landing, guiding the jumps through five levels as you work toward reaching her safely.

pages.title: Terrorist Shootout
pages.creator: AceViral.com LTD
pages.description: Terrorist Shootout puts you in the role of a soldier fighting through an occupied town. Aim at enemies and eliminate enough to complete each stage, reloading when needed. Spend progress between levels on improvements to the gun.

pages.title: Taxi Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Taxi Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a cab carrying passengers. Find the assigned destination and steer through the route to deliver the rider, using the brakes to manage the approach. Complete the transport tasks across the game's levels.

pages.title: Party Cat!
pages.creator: Ouzo games
pages.description: Party Cat! asks you to send a cat through every part of a room before the party starts. Swipe or use directional controls to choose its route, cleaning the area as it moves. Cover the whole room to complete the task.

pages.title: EG Swat Wars
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Swat Wars pits a lone SWAT fighter against groups of zombies. Move through the encounter, fire at the undead and reload when the weapon is empty. Buy additional weapons from the store to change how you tackle later fights.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tic Tac Toe lets two players compete to make a line of three matching marks. Choose an empty square and watch for horizontal, vertical or diagonal opportunities, blocking the opponent when needed. Computer players can fill in when a human rival is unavailable.

pages.title: Cookie Pig
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Cookie Pig puts a pig into an upward-jumping challenge. Time the mouse-controlled jumps to keep it rising, trying to beat the score recorded on your previous attempt as you continue the arcade climbing activity.

pages.title: Princess vs Superhero
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess vs Superhero lets you help Ladybug explore different sides of her style. Choose a superhero costume and an everyday outfit from the wardrobe, coordinating the pieces into looks that can give her a good-girl or mischievous appearance.

pages.title: Cars Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Cars Simulator gives you three cars and three environments for a driving session. Choose a vehicle and explore the available area, trying different routes as you compare how the cars handle their surroundings.

pages.title: Juice Bottle
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Juice Bottle challenges you to keep a bottle jumping across platforms. Time each hop toward a stable landing and watch the next gap, extending the run while trying to improve the score before a missed jump ends the attempt.

pages.title: Eggbot vs Zombies v2
pages.creator: Eggys Games
pages.description: Eggbot vs Zombies v2 sends a small robot into continuous battles with groups of zombies. Keep firing at the approaching undead and try different weapons from the available arsenal, reacting to the growing crowd as you work to sustain the fight.

pages.title: Color Snake
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Color Snake asks you to steer a colored snake through a field of obstacles. Break through pieces that match the snake's current color and avoid the others, choosing a route that lets it continue safely through the arrangement.

pages.title: Cute Animal Shapes
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cute Animal Shapes gives you animal pictures to assemble from separate pieces. Choose an animal and fit the sections into the complete outline, comparing the shapes as the full creature gradually appears on the board.

pages.title: Flying Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Flying Ball challenges you to guide a ball toward the top of each stage. Keep it clear of the saws along the route, choosing safe moments to pass through the gaps. Reach the upper goal to complete the level and continue.

pages.title: Construct A bridge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Construct A bridge puts you in charge of designing a bridge within a limited budget. Connect joints with structural lines and test the result by sending trucks across. Revise the arrangement until it supports the crossing without collapsing.

pages.title: Girls Fashion Advisers
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Girls Fashion Advisers follows Flynn visiting a group of fashion specialists for help with his clothes. Browse the styling choices and put together a new outfit for him, coordinating the pieces into a complete look.

pages.title: Roam Maze
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Roam Maze sends a character through randomly arranged platform mazes with time working against you. Move and jump through the passages, breaking through sections of the maze as you progress. Keep exploring to build a better score before the run ends.

pages.title: Princesses Talk Show VIP
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princesses Talk Show VIP prepares Ariel, Aurora and Cinderella for a television appearance. Choose makeup and elegant outfits for the three guests, coordinating a separate style for each princess before their visit to the talk show.

pages.title: WOW Girl
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: WOW Girl puts you alongside a beauty blogger making a makeup tutorial. Choose the cosmetic details for her look and complete the recording activity, working toward more likes within the game's fashion-and-beauty challenge.

pages.title: Neon Words
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Neon Words gives you a group of letters to turn into words. Select the letters in a useful order to fill the empty word panels, looking for every required answer. Use a hint when a missing word becomes difficult to identify.

pages.title: Princess Doll Christmas Decoration
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Doll Christmas Decoration combines dressing a princess doll with decorating her home for Christmas. Select festive clothes and accessories, then arrange seasonal details around the house to create a matching holiday look for the character and her surroundings.
